title: Scroll area
description: A fixed-size scrolling region (a long list in a card, a log). Semi hides scrollbars, so it marks the edges that have more content, can show a thin scrollbar, and is reachable by keyboard.
when: A list or log inside a card that must keep its height.
a11y: A labelled region that becomes focusable when it scrolls, so arrow keys scroll it.
